Cookie policy

Last updated: 13 October 2026

Legal informationPrivacy policyCookie policy

How we use browser storage

The current website has no targeted advertising, tracking pixels or analytics tools. Photographs, fonts and video are served from this website, without an embedded third-party video player or social network.

Remembering your choice

If you choose “Accept and remember”, your browser’s local storage saves the key heline-privacy-notice. It contains only the notice version, acknowledgement and expiry date. It contains no name, email address, advertising identifier or browsing history and is not sent to the server.

The record lasts for 180 days, approximately six months. When it expires, the record is discarded on your next visit and the notice reappears. It also reappears if this notice changes version. If you continue without saving, no choice is stored and the notice may appear on another page or a later visit.

Change or remove your choice

Use “Cookies and privacy” at the bottom left of every page, then “Remove my saved choice”. You can also remove this website’s data in your browser settings. Accepting this notice does not authorize any future tracker. Any new use requiring consent must have its own information and choice.

Security and hosting

The hosting provider may process technical information necessary to deliver and secure the website. Access to a private preview may also use its provider’s authentication mechanisms. These operations are not enabled by accepting this notice. See our privacy policy for hosting information and contact details.

Contact us

For questions: contact@helinefirst.com.
